entry.title: log aggregation, revisited
entry.content:
Every few months log aggregation bites me again. This is what finally stuck.

why it matters

Log aggregation shows up across devops work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Name it after what it does, not after how it does it.
  • Most of the value is in deleting, not adding.
  • If it is hard to test, that is the design telling you something.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.

entry.title: log aggregation, revisited
entry.content:
Short post: log aggregation is one of those things that looks simple until it isn’t.

why it matters

Log aggregation shows up across devops work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Write it down once, link to it everywhere.
  • Measure before you change anything; intuition is a poor profiler.
  • Prefer the obvious solution; clever costs interest forever.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.
